definition.name: Actual ordinary SMTP and verified guest TLS over declared TCP

steps.name: Install captured Go compiler namespace for published client
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Check exact input ownership cancellation and fail-closed selection
Authenticate the maintained compiler and official generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-smtp-tls-tools"
test ! -e "$out"
mkdir "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/go.tar.gz" https://dl.google.com/go/go1.27.3.linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "65efbc80fdc1fa2cd2631cad5b481777a68e8725f34e89f50fc6ac714e379b40  $out/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/go.tar.gz" -C "$out"
curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --max-time 180 --output "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go/releases/download/v0.4.3/componentize-go-linux-amd64.tar.gz
echo "1061d845f550df5d9477612a7d458a31b1e2b8bdc95823704e42e5064deb0c52  $out/componentize-go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$out/componentize-go.tar.gz" -C "$out" componentize-go
echo "b41803a645e54845bc8eacef9a69e0eeb8c2c4a9a61964c831ed544e85c137cb  $out/componentize-go" | sha256sum --check --strict
chmod 755 "$out/componentize-go"
test "$("$out/componentize-go" --version)" = 'componentize-go 0.4.3'
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$out/go" --output "$out/go-async"
echo "$out" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$out/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Compile ordinary SMTP guest TLS then execute one targeted signed harness
Retain bounded compiler and owner evidence including failures

with.name: go-smtp-tls-runtime-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/*.log
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/GO-SMTP-TLS-COMPILE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/GO-SMTP-PUBLISHED-COMPILE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/PUBLISHED-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/go.mod
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/go.sum
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/go-resolved.lock.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/latent.dependencies.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/latent.dependencies.lock.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/project/dependency-inputs/objects/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/authoring/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/authoring/logs/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/go-runtime-transformations.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/logs/**

${{ runner.temp }}/go-smtp-tls-runtime/fixture/build/component.wit
